metadata.description: This playlist is a little different. This game is similar to Story Stones, Story Sticks, or anything where the kids can choose a random rock or item and they have to either tell a story with that item or they can add to their story with the item. If someone starts the story with "Once upon a time, in a small village" and then goes to the next chapter on the Yoto, and it's Apple, then they need to work an Apple into the story somehow. Check out my transcript for all the details and ways to play!!
